description.fallback: Upon arriving at Konoha, Kakashi was confined to the hospital, making him unable to lead the team for a while. When reporting to Tsunade, they informed her about the meeting with Sasori's spy in ten days. In order to be able to go, Naruto needed to find a replacement for Sasuke.

intro.fallback: Upon arriving at Konoha, Kakashi was confined to the hospital, making him unable to lead the team for a while.
When reporting to Tsunade, they informed her about the meeting with Sasori's spy in ten days.
In order to be able to go, Naruto needed to find a replacement for Sasuke.

outro.fallback: Tsunade convinced them to let him go by assigning Tenzō, an Anbu, as the temporary leader of Team Kakashi, under the codename Yamato.
They were to travel to the Tenchi Bridge in Kusagakure to meet Sasori's spy.
